QtBridge.Settings.QmlLanguageServerLoggi: Controls QML Language Server process and LSP traffic logs. Changes apply on the next QML Language Server restart.
QtBridge.Settings.QmllsLogEnabled.Title: Enable QML Language Server verbose log
QtBridge.Settings.QmllsLogEnabled.Descri: Passes --verbose -l <path> to QML Language Server on startup so its internal diagnostics are written to qtbridge-qmlls.log in the configured directory.
QtBridge.Settings.QmllsLogDirectory.Desc: Directory where qtbridge-qmlls.log is written. Has no effect when the QML Language Server log is disabled.
QtBridge.Settings.LspLogEnabled.Title: Enable LSP traffic log
QtBridge.Settings.LspLogEnabled.Descript: Writes every LSP message exchanged between Visual Studio and QML Language Server to qtbridge-lsp.log in the configured directory.
QtBridge.Settings.LspLogDirectory.Title: LSP log directory
QtBridge.Settings.LspLogDirectory.Descri: Directory where qtbridge-lsp.log is written. Has no effect when the LSP log is disabled.
